payload.name: Windsor.ai Instagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Instagram helps creators and marketers analyze live Instagram organic performance. Users can discover connected Instagram Business or Creator accounts, inspect valid fields and options, query account and media insights — followers, reach, impressions, profile and website clicks, and engagement — and connect the Instagram connector. It covers organic Instagram analytics only: it does not run write actions (Instagram publishing is not enabled), cover Instagram Ads (use the Meta Ads connector), or provide ad cost data. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Instagram 帮助创作者和营销人员分析实时 Instagram 自然流量成效。用户可以发现已连接的 Instagram Business 或 Creator 账户，查看有效字段和选项，查询账户及媒体洞察数据——粉丝数、触达量、展示次数、个人资料和网站点击量、互动情况——并连接 Instagram 连接器。它仅涵盖 Instagram 自然流量分析：不执行写入操作（未启用 Instagram 发布功能）、不涵盖 Instagram Ads（请使用 Meta Ads 连接器），也不提供广告费用数据。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Retell AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone calls for your business. Retell powers call center automation for receptionists, sales outreach, collections, customer support, and more. Use ChatGPT to create agent prompts, configure call transfers, edit settings, and deploy to live phone numbers - all conversationally.
payload.longDescription:
该插件构建并部署语音代理。以下功能和限制适用：
Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone calls for your business. Retell powers call center automation for receptionists, sales outreach, collections, customer support, and more. Use ChatGPT to create agent prompts, configure call transfers, edit settings, and deploy to live phone numbers - all conversationally.

payload.name: Infojobs Brasil
payload.description: 在 Infojobs Brasil 找工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Acesse milhares de vagas de emprego no Brasil diretamente do ChatGPT. Pesquise por palavra-chave e localização, filtre por tipo de contrato e salário. Visualize os resultados em cards interativos com informações completas de cada vaga: empresa, localização, salário e descrição. Clique para ver detalhes completos no Infojobs Brasil.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 搜索巴西数千个工作职位。按关键词和地点搜索，并按合同类型和薪资筛选。通过交互式卡片查看职位完整信息，包括公司、地点、薪资和职位描述。点击即可在 Infojobs Brasil 查看完整详情。

payload.name: PDF Editor by PDF net
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in ChatGPT. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.

Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.

Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.

Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.
payload.longDescription:
将 pdf.net 连接到 ChatGPT，以便编辑、生成和整理 PDF。你的 pdf.net 资料库会直接连接，无需每次重新上传。

直接编辑 PDF：修改文本、修正日期、填写表单。通过提示词生成新 PDF，例如发票、合同和提案。最多合并 20 个 PDF，按页码范围拆分、压缩，并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档，同时保留版式。将资料库整理到文件夹中。

处理 PDF 可能很慢。你得先转换为 Word 才能编辑，切换工具来合并，额外付费翻译，还得翻找文件夹找文件。pdf.net 把这些操作全部放在一个聊天中。

直接编辑 PDF，无需往返转换 Word。通过提示词生成发票、合同和提案。最多合并 20 个文件，按页拆分、压缩，并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档并保留版式。你的 pdf.net 资料库保持连接，随时发条消息就能访问文件。

payload.name: iZap
payload.description: 管理 WhatsApp 企业业务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect iZap to manage your WhatsApp customer conversations without leaving the chat. Check how your day is going at a glance — message volume, how much your AI assistant is handling versus your team, and how long conversations are taking. Search and read your chat history, look up contacts, and send WhatsApp messages or approved templates on the spot. Launch broadcast campaigns with a preview step before anything goes out, and track their delivery. You can also set up and fine-tune the AI assistants that reply to your customers — create a new one or update its instructions in seconds.

Everything runs against your own authenticated iZap business, so you see your real numbers and your real conversations.
payload.longDescription:
连接 iZap，在聊天中管理 WhatsApp 客户对话。查看消息量、AI 助手与团队处理比例和对话时长；搜索和阅读历史、查找联系人、发送消息或已批准模板；预览后发起广播并跟踪送达；设置和微调回复客户的 AI 助手。所有操作都针对经过认证的

iZap 企业账户，显示真实数据和对话。

payload.name: Business Helper
payload.description: 有来源支持的商业答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source-
backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about strategy, product, marketing, or operations, the app enriches responses
with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it
clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally
without external references.

Business Helper does not collect personal data, and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based on user's intentions only.
payload.longDescription:
Business Helper 通过加入来自可信专家材料的可靠、有来源支持的上下文，改善 ChatGPT 对商业问题的回答。

当用户询问战略、产品、营销或运营时，应用会用相关示例和现实洞察参考来丰富回答。只有在明确能提升实用性时才会加入上下文；如果找不到相关来源，ChatGPT 会像平常一样回答，不添加外部引用。

Business Helper 不收集个人数据，也不提供专业法律或财务建议。任何外部服务都只根据用户意图推荐。

payload.name: Namify
payload.description: 从创意到域名，即刻完成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.

What makes Namify different is that it doesn't stop at "is this domain free?" Every suggestion can be vetted for full brand-readiness: run a trademark check to spot legal conflicts, and a social-handle check to confirm the name is available across major platforms. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.
payload.longDescription:
Namify 将一个想法变成可打造品牌且可注册的域名，无需反复把各种变体输入搜索框。用自然语言描述业务、输入一个单词概念，或粘贴带首选后缀的种子域名，Namify 就会即时返回相关名称建议，并显示多个 TLD 的实时可用性。

Namify 的特点不止于回答“这个域名是否空闲”。每个建议都可进行完整品牌就绪检查：运行商标检查以发现法律冲突，并检查社交账号名称以确认各大平台是否可用。它为希望名称真正适合作为品牌的人提供域名发现，而不只是一个碰巧未注册的 URL。

适用于为新企业、副业项目、应用或产品发布命名，并在一次对话中从想法走到可注册域名。

payload.name: AI Business Plan by PrometAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PrometAI helps users generate a complete business plan PDF from a few key business details. Users provide their company name, business description, country, and email, then PrometAI creates a business plan, generates a downloadable PDF, and sends access instructions so they can continue editing the plan on the PrometAI platform.
payload.longDescription: PrometAI 帮助用户根据少量关键业务信息生成完整的商业计划书 PDF。用户提供公司名称、业务描述、国家和电子邮件，随后 PrometAI 创建商业计划书，生成可下载的 PDF，并发送访问说明，方便用户在 PrometAI 平台继续编辑计划书。

payload.name: Datasite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your Datasite virtual data room - the secure workspace where thousands of M&A deals are facilitated annually. Set up folder structures, invite users, search documents, track buyer Q&A, and audit data room readiness, all through natural language. No workflow interruptions. No security trade-offs. Built for advisors, bankers, and corporate development teams - backed by the enterprise security and permissioning every transaction demands.

1. Set up a deal room - "Create a new Datasite Prepare data room for Project Alpha, set up a standard M&A folder index, and invite sarah@advisorfirm.com as an admin."

2. Search documents semantically - "Search the data room for any documents related to pending litigation or regulatory risk."

3. Track buyer Q&A - "Show me all open Q&A questions in the data room and draft responses where we have supporting documents."

4. Audit deal room readiness - "Check the data room for empty folders, missing documents, and any files flagged as password-protected or blank before we go live."

5. Manage user access - "Create a buyer role with view-only permissions and create draft invitations for the following five contacts from Acme Capital."

payload.name: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale helps online sellers find products for their online stores. Discover millions of premium dropshipping and wholesale products from verified global suppliers. Ask for products by category, image, price, location, popularity, or minimum profit margin. Explore top-selling items, add products to your store, check orders and performance, and learn about Syncee in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Syncee AI Dropship & Wholesale 帮助网店卖家为线上商店寻找商品。从经过验证的全球供应商处发现数百万种优质代发货和批发商品。可以按类别、图片、价格、地点、人气或最低利润率查找商品。探索畅销商品、将商品添加到商店、查看订单和业绩，并在 ChatGPT 中了解 Syncee。

payload.name: Zendrop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zendrop helps ecommerce merchants manage dropshipping operations from ChatGPT. Users can search the Zendrop catalog, add and import products to connected stores, inspect store, order, billing, and performance data, update fulfillment and tracking settings, preview fulfillment costs, and confirm guarded order fulfillment, cancellation, address, and product-linking workflows.
payload.longDescription: Zendrop 帮助电商商家直接在 ChatGPT 中管理一件代发业务。用户可以搜索 Zendrop 商品目录、将商品添加并导入已连接的商店、查看商店、订单、账单和业绩数据、更新履约和物流跟踪设置、预览履约成本，并确认受保护的订单履约、取消、地址及商品关联流程。

payload.name: Seismic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Seismic MCP Connector for ChatGPT enables secure integration between ChatGPT and Seismic, allowing ChatGPT to generate accurate, Seismic-specific responses using approved sales and enablement content.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector provides authentication and scope-based access control, ensuring only authorized tools and content are available within ChatGPT.

To configure access, users must install the MCP Connector for ChatGPT app from Seismic Exchange, where tenant admins define scopes and permissions that control which Seismic capabilities are exposed.

Once configured:

ChatGPT connects to Seismic through the MCP server

Only approved tools and content are accessible

Responses are grounded in trusted, compliant materials

Without proper installation and scope configuration, Seismic tools will not be visible in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
适用于 ChatGPT 的 Seismic MCP Connector 可在 ChatGPT 与 Seismic 之间实现安全集成，让 ChatGPT 使用获批的销售和赋能内容生成准确、针对 Seismic 的回复。

该连接器基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 构建，提供身份验证和基于范围的访问控制，确保 ChatGPT 中仅开放获授权的工具和内容。

要配置访问权限，用户必须从 Seismic Exchange 安装适用于 ChatGPT 的 MCP Connector 应用；租户管理员会在其中定义要开放的 Seismic 功能范围及权限。

配置完成后：

ChatGPT 通过 MCP 服务器连接 Seismic

仅可访问获批的工具和内容

回复以可信、合规的材料为依据

如果没有正确安装和配置访问范围，Seismic 工具将不会在 ChatGPT 中显示。

payload.name: iubenda
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language. Run cookie scans to detect trackers, then update your policies to match as your site changes. Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet GDPR, ePrivacy, US state privacy laws, and privacy requirements across markets, without the manual overhead.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 助手连接到 iubenda，从头到尾处理网站法律合规。通过自然语言创建和管理网站，生成根据所用服务定制的隐私和 Cookie 政策，添加数据处理服务，设置 Cookie 同意横幅并起草条款。运行 Cookie 扫描检测跟踪器，并在网站变化时更新政策。面向需要满足 GDPR、ePrivacy、美国州隐私法及各市场隐私要求的创始人、代理商和开发者。

payload.name: Ashby
payload.description: 分析招聘数据并采取行动
payload.summaryOriginal: Analyze and act on hiring data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts. Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat. Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

Try prompts like these:
“Summarize our current engineering pipeline, highlight bottlenecks, and identify at-risk candidates.”
"Consider [Candidate Name] for our open Staff Engineer role and move them to the recruiter screen stage."
“Generate a debrief summary for [Candidate Name] using interview feedback, scorecards, and recruiter notes.”
“Analyze time-to-fill trends across sales roles and summarize where delays are occurring.”
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 中的 Ashby 让你即时访问招聘流程、候选人资料、在招职位、面试及文字记录。提问、发现招聘趋势，并直接在聊天中添加备注、调整候选人所处阶段或发送邮件。Ashby 通过安全的用户级 OAuth，将 ChatGPT 连接到实时招聘数据。每项请求和操作都遵循你现有的权限，确保数据受到保护。

可以尝试以下提示词：
“总结我们当前的工程岗位招聘流程，指出瓶颈，并找出有流失风险的候选人。”
“考虑让 [候选人姓名] 应聘我们在招的 Staff Engineer 岗位，并将其移至招聘人员初筛阶段。”
“利用面试反馈、评分表和招聘人员备注，生成 [候选人姓名] 的面试复盘摘要。”
“分析销售岗位招聘周期的变化趋势，并总结延误发生在哪些环节。”

payload.name: AWeber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The AWeber MCP connects your AI assistant to your AWeber account, letting you manage email marketing through natural language. Instead of logging into AWeber, you can ask your assistant to manage subscribers, draft emails, analyze campaigns, and more — all through simple conversational requests.
payload.longDescription: AWeber MCP 将AI助手连接到你的 AWeber 账户，让你通过自然语言管理电子邮件营销。无需登录 AWeber，你可以通过简单的对话请求，让助手管理订阅者、起草邮件、分析营销活动，以及执行更多操作。

payload.name: Constant Contact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Go from email idea to a polished, ready-to-send campaign with the Constant Contact app. Describe the email you want, and the Constant Contact app will generate the HTML and render a live preview. Not quite right? Give feedback in chat, make edits, and preview again until it's exactly what you want. When you're ready to send, connect or create a Constant Contact account to import your email and reach your audience.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Constant Contact 应用，将邮件创意转化为精致且可直接发送的营销活动。描述你想要的邮件，Constant Contact 应用就会生成 HTML 并呈现实时预览。效果不理想？在聊天中提供反馈、进行修改并再次预览，直到完全符合你的要求。准备发送时，连接或创建 Constant Contact 账户，导入邮件并触达受众。

payload.name: Best Lawyers
payload.description: 搜索获同行认可的律师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for lawyers by practice area and location. Use the Best Lawyers directory to find peer-recognized attorneys by specialty (e.g. Corporate Law, Personal Injury), city, state, and country. Optionally filter to Lawyers of the Year. Results are based on Best Lawyers’ peer-review process.
payload.longDescription: 按执业领域和地点搜索律师。使用 Best Lawyers 目录，按专业（例如公司法、人身伤害）、城市、州和国家寻找获同行认可的律师。还可筛选年度律师。结果基于 Best Lawyers 的同行评审流程。

payload.name: Teamtailor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Teamtailor Public MCP lets authorized users search recruiting workspace data, inspect jobs, candidates, questions, organization structure and meeting records, and update job configuration, application questions, interview kits and skills from ChatGPT using the user's Teamtailor permissions.
payload.longDescription: Teamtailor Public MCP 允许获授权用户使用 ChatGPT 搜索招聘工作区数据、查看职位、候选人、问题、组织结构和会议记录，并根据用户的 Teamtailor 权限更新职位配置、申请问题、面试套件和技能。

payload.name: Apartments.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search millions of rental listings on Apartments.com directly from your conversation. Tell the assistant what you're looking for — city, neighborhood, price range, bedrooms, pet policy, amenities — and get curated results with photos, pricing, and availability in seconds. 

From a single chat you can explore floor plans, check unit availability, review fees and lease policies, get neighborhood insights, estimate affordability, schedule a tour, or contact a property directly.

No forms, no tab-switching, no scrolling through pages. Just describe your ideal home and let the assistant do the searching.
payload.longDescription:
直接在对话中搜索 Apartments.com 上数百万条租赁房源。告诉助手你的需求——城市、街区、价格范围、卧室数量、宠物政策、配套设施——几秒内即可获得精选结果，附照片、价格和可租情况。

在一次聊天中，你可以浏览户型图、查看房源可租情况、了解费用和租约政策、获取街区信息、估算负担能力、预约看房，或直接联系房源方。

无需填表、切换标签页或翻阅页面。只需描述理想的家，让助手帮你搜索。

payload.name: Arcads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Arcads helps users create and edit advertising videos, images, speech, and music in their workspace. Users can browse brands, actors, voices, and collected competitor ads; upload reference media; generate assets with supported models; and trim, combine, caption, translate, animate, or enhance existing media. AI analysis and prompt building support creative preparation. Processing runs as saved jobs and may consume workspace credits.
payload.longDescription: Arcads 帮助用户在工作区中创建和编辑广告视频、图像、语音和音乐。用户可以浏览品牌、演员、声音和收集的竞品广告；上传参考媒体；使用支持的模型生成素材；并对现有媒体进行裁剪、合并、添加字幕、翻译、制作动画或增强。AI 分析和提示词构建功能支持创意准备。处理过程以保存的任务运行，可能消耗工作区积分。

payload.name: Atria
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atria helps users research advertisers and ad-library creative, compare connected ad-account performance, and use Radar to identify creative to scale or improve. Users can organize reference ads in shared boards, maintain their own brand profiles and competitors, read or produce video transcripts, generate brand-based ad images, and save notes in Atria. Transcription, image generation, and Radar recommendations can consume workspace AI credits.

payload.name: Pet Project Co-Founder AI

Examples of questions you can get answers to:

- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"

Disclaimers:

But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.

Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)

payload.name: Postbeam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.
payload.longDescription:
Postbeam 将 ChatGPT 接入您的 LinkedIn 内容工作流，让您无需离开聊天即可起草、审阅、安排发布和分析帖子。

连接 Postbeam 账户后，ChatGPT 会直接使用您的真实帖子、写作指南和效果数据，让聊天框成为您实际运营 LinkedIn 账号和策略的工作空间。

使用您的真实工作内容，按您的风格起草：
让 ChatGPT 撰写帖子时，它会利用您在 Postbeam 中的内容训练、使命、受众、格式规则和内容来源，让每篇草稿都符合您的风格，而非千篇一律。由于它在 ChatGPT 中工作，也可以从您连接的其他工具（Slack 讨论串、Gmail、Fellow 或 Granola 等会议录音工具）中提取原始素材，将真实客户通话、已交付功能或团队成果转化为成稿。草稿会直接保存到 Postbeam 供审核。

编辑、整理并管理队列：
通过聊天查看最近的草稿、打开任意帖子，并编辑文案或标题。您可以附加图片、视频或轮播帖子等媒体。按状态（草稿、已批准、已安排）列出帖子，准确了解进展。

准备好后批准并安排发布：
草稿准备就绪后，ChatGPT 可以批准并安排在指定时间发布到已连接的 LinkedIn 账户。帖子不会自动发布，草稿会一直保持草稿状态，直到有人作出决定；批准或安排发布也会遵循您账户的权限。

了解哪些内容有效：
询问内容表现后，可从缓存的分析数据中获得答案：账户级汇总（展示次数、反应、评论、转发、增长粉丝数、触达成员数）及每日趋势，以及 30、90 或 365 天范围内的单帖明细。借此找出表现最佳的形式和开头，然后立即按已验证的风格起草下一篇帖子。

适用于团队和代理机构：
Postbeam 支持在一个位置管理多个账户。ChatGPT 可以列出您有权访问的每个账户，让代理机构和团队在客户或队友之间切换，同时清晰分开每个人的草稿、审批和分析数据。

Instead of digging through dashboards, exporting reports, or manually analyzing mentions, you can ask ChatGPT questions about your brand, competitors or campaigns and get answers based on your Brand24 data.

Whether you're a marketer, PR specialist, agency, or analyst, Brand24 app helps you turn online conversations into actionable insights in seconds.

What can you ask ChatGPT?
"What's the current sentiment around my brand?" - Instantly understand how people feel about your brand and identify the topics driving positive or negative conversations.
"Summarize my project from the last 30 days." - Get a concise overview of key trends, spikes in mentions, sentiment changes, and the most important discussions.
"Compare my brand with competitors." - Analyze share of voice, sentiment, reach, and discussion volume across multiple brands without building reports manually.
"What caused this spike in mentions?" - Quickly identify the events behind sudden increases in visibility.

Brand24 app makes ChatGPT more than just an AI assistant - it becomes a powerful source of real-time brand, market, and competitor intelligence powered by your Brand24 projects.
payload.longDescription:
将 Brand24 洞察直接带入 ChatGPT。

ChatGPT 中的 Brand24 应用通过简单对话，让您即时访问社交聆听洞察。您无需翻找仪表板、导出报告或手动分析提及，只需询问有关品牌、竞争对手或营销活动的问题，即可获得基于 Brand24 数据的答案。

无论您是营销人员、公关专家、代理机构还是分析师，Brand24 都能在几秒内帮助您把线上对话转化为可执行洞察。

您可以这样询问 ChatGPT：
“我的品牌当前的情绪如何？”——立即了解人们对品牌的感受，以及推动正面或负面讨论的主题。
“总结我过去 30 天的项目。”——概括关键趋势、提及峰值、情绪变化和最重要的讨论。
“将我的品牌与竞争对手比较。”——无需手动制作报告，即可分析多个品牌的声量份额、情绪、触达和讨论量。
“是什么导致提及量激增？”——快速找出曝光度突然上升背后的事件。

Brand24 应用让 ChatGPT 不只是 AI 助手，而是由您的 Brand24 项目驱动的实时品牌、市场和竞争情报来源。

payload.name: Strety
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中运营公司
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Strety helps leadership teams review company context, find and manage priorities, update scorecards, work through issues, coordinate to-dos, and maintain shared operating documents through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Strety 帮助领导团队通过 ChatGPT 查看公司背景信息、查找和管理优先事项、更新记分卡、处理问题、协调待办事项，并维护共享的运营文档。

payload.name: Stratws
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Import indicator values into Stratws directly through ChatGPT. Update performance data more efficiently using a conversational experience integrated with your environment and the platform’s access permissions.
payload.longDescription: 通过与工作环境集成的平台权限，在 ChatGPT 中直接将指标数值导入 Stratws。借助对话式体验，更高效地更新绩效数据。

payload.name: Lattice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens every day in 1:1s, in Slack, in the doc you're drafting at 9pm, and increasingly in the AI assistant you open before your email. Lattice MCP connects every signal you've already collected (reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and weekly updates) into ChatGPT, so the agent you already use can finally see your team the way you do.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your actual people data. Draft an accurate review in 90 seconds. Submit it without leaving the conversation. Outline the calibration story before justifying it in the meeting. Because Lattice MCP respects your existing Lattice permissions, every answer is scoped to exactly what you'd see in-product.

For AI-native organizations with adoption initiatives already in motion and other MCP connectors running in their stack, Lattice MCP is the missing piece. Bring your reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and updates into the same chat your managers are already prompting in. Draft from the full picture. Submit the result back to Lattice without ever leaving the conversation. That's the round-trip no other best-in-class Performance Management tool completes today.
payload.longDescription:
绩效管理并不只发生在绩效管理软件中。它每天都发生在1:1 谈话、Slack、你晚上 9 点正在起草的文档里，也越来越多地发生在你查看邮件前打开的 AI 助手中。Lattice MCP 将你已收集的各种信号（评估、1:1 谈话、反馈、目标和每周更新）接入 ChatGPT，让你常用的智能体终于能像你一样了解团队。

提出问题，即可获得基于真实人员数据的回答。90 秒内起草准确的评估，并且无需离开对话即可提交。在会议中说明理由之前，先梳理校准讨论的依据。由于 Lattice MCP 遵循你现有的 Lattice 权限，每个回答的范围都严格限于你在产品中有权查看的内容。

对于已经启动 AI 应用计划并在技术栈中运行其他 MCP 连接器的 AI 原生组织来说，Lattice MCP 补上了缺失的一环。将评估、1:1 谈话、反馈、目标和更新带入管理者已经在使用的同一个聊天中。依据完整信息起草内容，并在不离开对话的情况下将结果提交回 Lattice。这是目前其他一流绩效管理工具尚未实现的完整往返工作流。

payload.name: Zoom Revenue Accelerator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Zoom Revenue Accelerator to look up sales conversations, transcripts, AI summaries, deals, teams, and coaching scorecards. Ask natural-language questions about customer meetings and pipeline activity, then get grounded answers from the records you already have access to.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Zoom Revenue Accelerator，以查询销售对话、转录稿、AI 摘要、交易、团队和辅导评分卡。使用自然语言询问客户会议和销售管道活动，并从你已有权限访问的记录中获得有依据的答案。

payload.name: Meltwater
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Meltwater MCP server connects AI tools and workflows to Meltwater’s media and social intelligence. Search billions of news articles and social posts, retrieve live metrics, trends, and sentiment, generate Boolean queries, and manage saved searches — all through natural language. Requires an active Meltwater subscription.
payload.longDescription: Meltwater MCP 服务器将 AI 工具和工作流连接到 Meltwater 的媒体与社交媒体情报。通过自然语言搜索数十亿篇新闻文章和社交帖子，获取实时指标、趋势与情绪分析，生成布尔查询，并管理已保存的搜索。需要有效的 Meltwater 订阅。

payload.name: Enginy
payload.description: 查找并联系 B2B 联系人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Enginy helps B2B sales and prospecting teams build lead lists, enrich contacts, and run outreach campaigns from ChatGPT.

Search for companies and people that match your ideal customer profile, then verify emails and phone numbers, find LinkedIn profiles, and organize the results into lists. Draft and launch multi-step email and LinkedIn sequences, review replies from your inbox, and check campaign and conversation analytics.

Enginy connects to your existing workspace, so you can work with the contacts, companies, lists, and campaigns your team already has, and keep everything in sync with your CRM. An Enginy account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Enginy 帮助 B2B 销售和潜在客户开发团队通过 ChatGPT 建立潜在客户名单、补充联系人信息并开展外联活动。

搜索符合理想客户画像的公司和人员，然后验证电子邮箱和电话号码、查找 LinkedIn 个人资料，并将结果整理到列表中。起草并启动多步骤电子邮件和 LinkedIn 触达序列、查看收件箱回复，并检查活动与对话分析。

Enginy 连接到你现有的工作区，因此你可以使用团队已有的联系人、公司、列表和活动，并与 CRM 保持同步。需要 Enginy 账户。

payload.name: SurveySparrow: Forms & Surveys
payload.description: 创建并运行表单或调查
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and run forms or surveys
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.

What you can do:
- Design surveys and forms for any use-case (NPS, feedback, employee engagement, and more)
- Publish surveys to your SurveySparrow account and distribute them via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
- Review live response counts and track survey activity across your account
- Analyze responses and surface patterns or key themes from collected data

Example prompts:

1. Build a survey
"Create an NPS survey for customers who purchased in the last 30 days with a rating scale and an open-ended follow-up question"

2. Edit a survey
"Add a required email field and make question 5 more concise"

3. Publish a survey
"Publish this survey to my SurveySparrow account so it's ready to collect responses"

4. Share a survey
"Send this NPS survey to my customer list via email"

5. Check response activity
"How many people have completed the customer feedback form?"

6. Track your survey library
"How many NPS surveys are active right now?"

7. Analyze responses
"Group the responses by common themes and show me the top 3 insights"

Requirements: An active SurveySparrow account is required to use this app.
payload.longDescription:
在单次 ChatGPT 对话中使用 SurveySparrow 应用创建调查和表单、将其分发给受访者并分析结果。

你可以：
- 针对各种用途设计调查和表单（NPS、反馈、员工参与度等）
- 将调查发布到 SurveySparrow 账户，并通过电子邮件、SMS 或 WhatsApp 分发
- 查看实时回复数量并跟踪账户中的调查活动
- 分析回复，并从收集的数据中提炼规律或关键主题

示例提示：

1. 创建调查
“为过去 30 天内购买过商品的客户创建一份 NPS 调查，包含评分量表和一道开放式后续问题。”

2. 编辑调查
“添加必填电子邮件字段，并让第 5 个问题更简洁。”

3. 发布调查
“将这份调查发布到我的 SurveySparrow 账户，以便开始收集回复。”

4. 分享调查
“通过电子邮件将这份 NPS 调查发送给我的客户名单。”

5. 查看回复活动
“有多少人填写了客户反馈表？”

6. 跟踪调查库
“目前有多少份 NPS 调查处于启用状态？”

7. 分析回复
“按常见主题对回复分组，并展示最重要的 3 项洞察。”

使用此应用需要有效的 SurveySparrow 账户。

payload.name: LicitaLAB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LicitaLAB permite encontrar, analizar y entender compras públicas de forma rápida y estructurada.
La plataforma extrae información clave desde documentos de licitación, incluyendo requisitos técnicos, plazos, montos y criterios de evaluación, facilitando la comprensión de cada oportunidad sin necesidad de revisar archivos extensos.
Los usuarios pueden explorar oportunidades, revisar documentos asociados y tomar decisiones informadas en menos tiempo. Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje natural sobre oportunidades específicas, proveedores, compradores y sobre el uso de la plataforma.
LicitaLAB está diseñada para profesionales y organizaciones que participan en compras públicas y necesitan evaluar múltiples procesos de manera eficiente, reduciendo el tiempo de análisis y mejorando la calidad de sus ofertas.
payload.longDescription:
LicitaLAB 能够快速、系统地查找、分析和理解公共采购信息。
该平台从招标文件中提取关键信息，包括技术要求、截止日期、金额和评估标准，让用户无需通读冗长文件即可理解每个机会。
用户可以探索采购机会、查看相关文件，并在更短时间内做出明智决策。此外，还可用自然语言询问具体机会、供应商、采购方以及平台使用方法。
LicitaLAB 面向参与公共采购、需要高效评估多个流程的专业人士和组织，帮助缩短分析时间并提升投标质量。

payload.name: Arcade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Arcade lets you build branded product videos and demos directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools or tabs. Give ChatGPT a prompt, screenshots, or notes from a call, and it generates an on-brand video with visuals, animations, and narration. You can also query performance data from your existing Arcades to see which demos are driving engagement. Useful for product marketing, sales follow-ups, product releases, and paid ads. Use together with other Apps such as Figma, Granola, Notion, Slack, and Apollo to automate workflows end to end.
payload.longDescription: Arcade 让你直接通过 ChatGPT 制作符合品牌风格的产品视频和演示，无需切换工具或标签页。向 ChatGPT 提供提示、截图或通话笔记，它就会生成包含画面、动画和旁白、符合品牌形象的视频。你也可以查询现有 Arcade 演示的表现数据，了解哪些演示在推动互动。适用于产品营销、销售跟进、产品发布和付费广告。与 Figma、Granola、Notion、Slack 和 Apollo 等其他应用配合使用，可实现端到端工作流程自动化。

payload.name: Outreach
payload.description: 面向收入团队的 AI 代理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Outreach knowledge and actions into ChatGPT so your teams can move faster, combine insights across systems, and complete advanced revenue tasks without switching tools. Outreach is an end-to-end AI Revenue Platform for all go-to-market teams. By embedding agentic AI across every revenue workflow, Outreach increases sales productivity, boosts pipeline, and gives leaders the visibility and predictability they need to grow revenue at scale.
payload.longDescription: 将 Outreach 的知识和操作带入 ChatGPT，让团队更快行动、跨系统整合洞察，并完成高级收入任务而无需切换工具。Outreach 是面向所有市场进入团队的端到端 AI 收入平台。通过在每个收入工作流中嵌入代理式 AI，Outreach 提高销售生产力、扩大销售管道，并为领导者提供规模化增长所需的可见性和可预测性。

payload.name: Blinq
payload.description: 查找联系人和搜索笔记
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Interact with Blinq via ChatGPT. The AI contacts app for people who meet people.

Leverage Blinq's powerful contacts and notetaking features within ChatGPT to act on your relationships.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 与 Blinq 互动。这是一款面向经常与人打交道的人士的 AI 联系人应用。

在 ChatGPT 中利用 Blinq 强大的联系人和笔记功能，推动人际关系中的实际行动。

payload.name: Domotz – Network Monitoring
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Monitor and manage your network infrastructure through natural language. Ask about sites, devices, alerts, connectivity, and network health without switching tools. The Domotz MCP server helps turn infrastructure data into clear answers, faster troubleshooting, and actionable operational insights for IT teams and managed service providers.
payload.longDescription: 通过自然语言监控和管理网络基础设施。无需切换工具，即可询问站点、设备、告警、连接状态和网络健康情况。Domotz MCP 服务器可帮助 IT 团队和托管服务提供商将基础设施数据转化为清晰答案、更快速的故障排查和可执行的运营见解。

payload.name: Knowify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Knowify helps users inspect tenant-scoped construction and service business data from ChatGPT, including project records, report models, invoices, time entries, schemas, and platform knowledge needed to answer operational questions.
payload.longDescription: Knowify 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中查看租户范围内的建筑和服务企业数据，包括项目记录、报告模型、发票、工时记录、架构，以及回答运营问题所需的平台知识。

payload.name: Workable MCP Server
payload.description: 管理 Workable 人力资源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Workable MCP Server helps users work with their Workable account from ChatGPT: discover accounts, inspect jobs and candidates, manage candidate workflow actions, handle employee lookup, time off, time tracking, requisitions, offers, departments, and performance review templates.
payload.longDescription: Workable MCP Server 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 Workable 账号：查找账号、查看职位和候选人、管理候选人流程操作、查询员工、休假和工时、处理职位申请和录用、管理部门及绩效评审模板。

payload.name: BrightEdge
payload.description: 分析 AEO 和 SEO 可见度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, and recommendations. Invoke this app when a user requests prompt citations or mentions, keyword rankings, keyword and prompt management, AEO and SEO competitive visibility, including queries phrased as improvement guidance that require account-specific data rather than general inference. ChatGPT helps users work with BrightEdge data more effectively by combining analyses across different datasets, asking follow-up questions, and turning SEO and AEO metrics into clear insights within a single conversation.
payload.longDescription: BrightEdge 应用会从用户已连接的 BrightEdge 账户中提取指标，涵盖 AEO、GEO 以及跨大语言模型的传统 SEO 表现。它会返回 AEO 引用和提及、AEO 与 SEO 竞争对手基准对比、关键字排名数据、页面级表现、竞争份额（Share of Voice）评分、Google Search Console 和网页分析指标、AI Overview 引用差距分析以及建议。当用户请求查询提示词的引用或提及、关键字排名、关键字和提示词管理、AEO 和 SEO 竞争可见度时，应调用此应用；如果用户以改进建议的方式提问，但需要账户专属数据而非一般推断，也应调用。ChatGPT 会结合不同数据集的分析、提出后续问题，并在单次对话中将 SEO 和 AEO 指标转化为清晰洞察，帮助用户更有效地使用 BrightEdge 数据。

payload.name: GST Invoice Maker
payload.description: 免费打印 GST 账单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GST Invoice Maker creates GST-compliant bills for Indian shops, restaurants, kiranas, and freelancers. Ask for a bill in plain language and get computed totals plus a link that opens the bill fully filled in — ready to print or save as PDF. Also provides ready-made downloadable bill format PDFs and a GST reference guide (required invoice fields, rate slabs). Free, no account needed, and bill data is processed in-memory — never stored.
payload.longDescription: GST Invoice Maker 为印度商店、餐厅、杂货店和自由职业者创建符合 GST 要求的账单。用日常语言描述账单需求，即可获得计算后的总额和一个已填妥账单的链接，可直接打印或保存为 PDF。还提供可下载的账单格式 PDF 模板和 GST 参考指南（必填发票字段、税率档）。免费使用，无需账号；账单数据仅在内存中处理，不会保存。

payload.name: DirectCase Legal Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DirectCase Legal Research helps legal professionals find verified legislation, case law, regulatory decisions, company-register records, and legislative updates. It returns primary-source links and citations so users can inspect the original legal material.
payload.longDescription: DirectCase Legal Research 可帮助法律专业人士查找经核实的法律法规、判例法、监管决定、公司登记记录和立法更新。它提供一手来源链接和引文，方便用户查阅法律原始材料。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
[Early Preview] Aris helps you on understanding high level view on how to approach having your own company website, internal systems or even AI agent. By understanding your business problem and requirements, Aris will provide input grounded with industrial knowledge from KONGMY Digital Consultancy.

payload.name: Sprinto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sprinto helps authorized organization users inspect compliance status, search policies and evidence, answer security questionnaires, and manage audits, controls, risks, vendors, people, policies, tasks, and evidence from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Sprinto 帮助获得授权的组织用户通过 ChatGPT 查看合规状态、搜索政策和证据、回答安全问卷，并管理审计、控制措施、风险、供应商、人员、政策、任务和证据。

payload.name: Adobe Experience Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create, edit, search, and publish pages and content fragments in Adobe Experience Manager — simply by describing what you need. Instead of navigating the user interface, write what to do in plain language: update a hero banner, find pages about a campaign, or schedule content for launch. All changes respect your AEM permissions. Work faster, reduce repetitive tasks, and stay focused on what matters most — your content.
payload.longDescription: 只需描述需求，即可在 Adobe Experience Manager 中创建、编辑、搜索和发布页面及内容片段。无需操作用户界面，用自然语言写出要做的事情，例如更新主视觉横幅、查找与某项营销活动相关的页面，或安排内容在发布时上线。所有修改都遵守你的 AEM 权限。更快开展工作、减少重复任务，并专注于最重要的内容。

payload.name: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

payload.name: STACK
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.
